title: Glowing Rune Stone
description: A large pyramidal stone structure composed of glowing orange, red, and brown fragments sits centrally on rocky ground. It is wrapped in dark chains and covered with floating golden runes and symbols against a dark, moody background filled with swirling clouds and colorful bokeh light orbs.
